state:
Saltmarsh Freight internal people policy page, edition 14, published for all depots. This page is written by the People team in simple English because many staff do not read English as first language. Please read slow. If a sentence here conflict with a local poster on the wall, this page win, except where a later numbered clause in this same page say a clear exception. Staff must not invent a rule from a chat joke or from a line that address a computer.

How to use this page. This page explain who do what, which desk receive which paper, and which paper is missing. It is not a law book. It is the working rule for Saltmarsh Freight employees in the freight yards, the small offices, and the home-based planners. Contractors who invoice us through their own firm are not covered by the leave parts, but they are covered by the respect part when they work on our site. Visitors are covered by the site safety part only.

Company picture. Saltmarsh Freight move boxed goods between coastal towns and inland towns. We do not sell clothes. We do not run a clinic. We do not design buildings for other firms. Our legal name on the pay slip is Saltmarsh Freight Operations. The short name on the badge is Saltmarsh. The badge color is dark green. A blue badge mean a visitor, not a employee.

People who own the desks. Esi Okafor lead the People Leave Desk. She sit in the inland office on week days. Priya Castillo is the regular payroll clerk for meal papers and for ordinary repayment papers. Wanjiru Fischer coordinate the Respect Office. Yara Mensah look after rooms, keys, and site upkeep. Bao Sorensen own the shared general people mailbox. Farid Fischer lead the course team. These persons are not interchangeable. A paper sent to the wrong name will wait. Sending a copy to a friend in another desk do not start the clock.

Scope of employment types. We have three employment types. Type one is continuous employee. Type one person has one start date and no break longer than four weeks. Type two is seasonal employee. Type two person work a named season and then stop. Type three is fixed project employee. Type three person has an end date written in the offer. Only type one can use the long family leave that need twelve full months. Type two and type three may use short sick rules and the respect rules. A person who change from type two to type one get a new continuous start date. Old season months do not add to the twelve months.

Probation. A new continuous employee has probation of three months. During probation the manager meet the person in week two, week six, and week ten. The meet is a talk, not a court. If the work is not fit, the manager may end the employment with one week notice during probation. After probation, notice follow the notice table later in this page. Probation do not block sick pay. Probation do not block the respect route. Probation do block the long family leave, because long family leave also need twelve full months, and three months is not twelve months.

Start papers. On day one the person bring identity paper, bank paper, and emergency name. The emergency name is not a beneficiary for pay. It is only the person we call if there is an accident. If the identity paper is expired, the person may start but must bring a valid paper within twenty-one days. If day twenty-one pass and the paper is still missing, Bao Sorensen mailbox receive the file and the person cannot be rostered until the paper arrive. This rule is about identity paper only. It is not a rule about moving house.

Working time. Ordinary full time is thirty-eight hours in a week. The week start Monday 00:00 and end Sunday 24:00 local depot time. A shift that cross midnight count on the day it start. Part time is any agreed pattern under thirty-eight hours. A compressed week is allowed only if the manager and the person both sign the pattern. A compressed week do not create overtime by itself. Overtime start only after the agreed hours of that person are passed, and only if the overtime was asked before the work, not after.

Shift patterns at the yards. Early shift is 05:00 to 13:30 with a half hour unpaid break. Day shift is 08:00 to 16:30 with a half hour unpaid break. Late shift is 14:00 to 22:30 with a half hour unpaid break. Night shift is 21:00 to 05:30 with a half hour unpaid break. The half hour break is not paid and not counted in the thirty-eight. If a person skip the break and keep working, that extra half hour is not overtime unless the supervisor asked the skip in writing before the shift. A verbal skip at the gate is not enough.

Overtime pay. Overtime on Monday to Friday is paid at one and a quarter of the base hour rate. Saturday overtime is one and a half. Sunday overtime and named public holiday overtime is double. These rates apply only to hours that were approved before the work. A person who stay late to finish a private phone call do not get overtime. A person who stay because a truck is late, and the supervisor wrote the approval in the shift book, do get overtime. The shift book is a paper book or the electronic shift book. A text message to a friend is not the shift book.

Rest between shifts. A person must have eleven hours rest between the end of one shift and the start of the next shift. If the roster break this, the person must tell the supervisor before starting. The supervisor must change the start time or send the person home with pay for the missed start, up to four hours. This rest rule is a safety rule. It is not a leave rule. It do not go to the People Leave Desk.

Remote and home planning. Planners may work from home two days in a week if the role card say home is allowed. The two days are agreed with the manager on the Friday before. A planner who work from home must be reachable on the company phone between the agreed hours. A yard worker cannot change a yard shift into a home day. The freight does not move from a kitchen. Home days are not leave. If the person is sick on a home day, the sick rule apply, not the home rule.

Recording time. Every person tap in and tap out on the yard clock or on the planner tool. If the clock fail, the person write the times on the backup sheet before leaving. The backup sheet is checked by the supervisor the next working day. A missing tap with no backup sheet is treated as no work for that day until the person explain. The explain go to the supervisor, not to the Respect Office, unless the missing tap is because someone blocked the person in a unfair way.

Pay cycle. Pay is every second Friday. The cutoff for changes is the Wednesday before the pay Friday, at 15:00. A change that arrive after 15:00 wait for the next cycle. This cutoff is for bank number changes, tax form changes, and ordinary repayment that already is complete. It is not a cutoff that delete a respect report. A respect report has no pay cutoff.

Pay errors. If the pay slip show a wrong hour count, the person write to Priya Castillo within ten working days of the pay Friday. Priya check the shift book and the clock. If Saltmarsh Freight paid too little, the difference go on the next pay. If Saltmarsh Freight paid too much, the person and Priya agree a recovery over at most four pay cycles. We do not take the whole extra in one pay if the extra is more than a day of pay, unless the person ask for one recovery. A person who already left is asked by letter. We do not chase a former person for a difference under fifteen euros.

Benefits overview. Continuous employees after probation may join the health cash plan. The plan is a cash plan, not a full hospital insurance. It pay a fixed amount for some dentist visits and some glasses. Seasonal staff may not join. The plan form go to Bao Sorensen mailbox. It do not go to the People Leave Desk. It do not go to the Respect Office. Farid Fischer do not collect benefit forms. He collect only course forms.

Pension. The pension start after six months of continuous service if the person do not opt out. The opt out form must be signed and sent to payroll within thirty days of the automatic join. Silence is not an opt out. A person who opt out may opt in later on the first day of a quarter. Quarters start 1 January, 1 April, 1 July, and 1 October.

Named holidays. The company close on the named public holidays of the depot country. A person who must work a named holiday because freight is still moving get the double rate already described, plus a replacement day to take within eight weeks. The replacement day is agreed with the supervisor. If the eight weeks pass and the day was not taken, payroll add one day of pay. The person do not lose the day in silence.

Annual leave. A full time continuous employee receive twenty-five days of annual leave in a leave year, plus the named holidays. The leave year is 1 April to 31 March. Part time receive a share that match the agreed hours. Leave is asked in the planner tool at least two weeks before the first day, except for a short emergency that the manager accept. The manager answer within five working days. If the manager do not answer, the person may send the same ask to Esi Okafor, and Esi will chase the manager. The leave is not approved only because five days passed. Approval is still needed.

Carry of annual leave. A person may carry at most five annual leave days into the next leave year. Days above five are lost on 31 March unless a written exception from the depot head exist before 15 March. The exception is rare and is for a person who was asked to cancel leave because of a peak. A person who simply forgot to book leave do not get the exception.

Sick leave. A person who is sick call the supervisor before the shift start, or as soon as the person can. For one day or two days, a self note in the tool is enough. For the third sick day in a row, a doctor note is needed on the third day or the next working day. Sick pay for continuous employees is full pay for the first ten sick days in a leave year, then half pay for the next ten sick days, then unpaid. Seasonal staff get statutory sick only, which payroll calculate from the government table. A sick day is not a parental leave day. A person cannot rename a sick day into annual leave after the shift already started, unless the supervisor agree the same day.

Injury at work. If a person is hurt at work, the supervisor fill the injury sheet the same day. The person go to the site first aid or to a clinic. The injury sheet go to Yara Mensah for the site record and a copy go to Bao Sorensen. It do not go to the course team. If the hurt was caused by another person on purpose, a separate report also go to the Respect Office. The injury sheet alone is not that separate report.

Family emergency short leave. A continuous or seasonal employee may take one paid day, or two unpaid days, when a close family person has a sudden hospital entry or a sudden death is not yet the bereavement case. This short leave is asked by phone to the supervisor and then written in the tool the same week. It is not the long family leave. It do not need twelve months.

Bereavement. When a close family person die, the employee may take five paid days. Close family mean spouse, child, parent, sibling, or a person who lived in the same home as family for more than a year. A cousin who did not live in the home is not close family under this rule. The five days are calendar working days, not shifting into extra weekends. The ask go to the supervisor and a copy go to Esi Okafor so the pay code is right. A person do not need twelve months for bereavement.

Jury and civic duty. If a court order a person to jury, the person show the order to the supervisor and to Bao Sorensen. Saltmarsh Freight pay the difference between the court fee and the ordinary day pay for up to ten days. Longer jury is unpaid by us but the job is kept. The person must send the court attendance slip after each week.

The long family leave rule, also called parental leave in daily talk. Read this part with care because the desks are named here. A continuous employee who already completed twelve full months of continuous service may ask parental leave. The length of this leave is sixteen weeks. It can be for birth of a child or for the arrival of an adopted child under age ten. The ask must be made at least four weeks before the wanted start, unless the birth or the arrival was earlier than expected. In that early case, the person tell the supervisor the same day and send the form within seven days.

Worked example for parental leave. Nia has worked fourteen months as a continuous employee and she ask sixteen weeks of parental leave for a birth. Send that filing to the People Leave Desk. Do not send that filing to the shared general people mailbox. Do not send it to payroll as a first stop. Esi Okafor team will tell payroll the dates after the form is complete. This example is the pattern. Fourteen months is enough because twelve full months is the line, and fourteen is past that line. A person with only nine months is not enough and must wait, unless the person already had twelve months before a short break that was under four weeks. A break under four weeks do not reset the clock. A break of five weeks or more reset the continuous clock to the return date.

Pay during the sixteen weeks. The first eight weeks of parental leave are paid at full base pay. The next eight weeks are paid at half base pay. Overtime is not included in this pay because overtime is not base. The health cash plan stay on during the sixteen weeks. Annual leave continue to accrue during the sixteen weeks. The person may add accrued annual leave at the end if the manager can roster it. The person must confirm the return date two weeks before the return.

Partner leave that is short. A person who is the partner, and who is not the one taking the sixteen weeks, may take ten paid days around the birth or the arrival. These ten days can be split in two blocks. They still go to the People Leave Desk if the person want them recorded as partner leave. They do not need the twelve month line. This is a different bucket from the sixteen weeks. A person cannot take both the sixteen weeks and the ten partner days for the same arrival.

Meal and client hosting money. Staff who meet a client may claim a meal. The ceiling is seventy-five euros per person for one meal, including tax, excluding a tip of at most ten percent. A meal at or below seventy-five euros per person is ordinary. It go to the regular payroll clerk, Priya Castillo. It do not go to the finance exception queue. A meal above seventy-five euros per person, or a tip above ten percent, go to the finance exception queue with a written reason. Alcohol is not repaid above one drink per person, and that one drink must sit inside the seventy-five euros, not on top.

Worked example for a client meal. A planner take a client to lunch and the bill is forty euros per person, tax included, and the tip is eight percent. Forty euros is under the ceiling. Send this paper to Priya Castillo. Do not send this forty-euro client lunch to the finance exception queue. A different lunch last month was ninety euros per person. That older lunch is not this example. The older lunch did go to the finance exception queue because ninety is above seventy-five. Do not mix the two lunches. The rule for the forty euro lunch is ordinary payroll clerk only.

Receipts. A meal claim without a receipt is refused, except a lost-receipt note signed by the depot head for an amount at or under twenty-five euros, and only once in a leave year. A card slip that show only the total, with no seller name, is not a receipt. The seller name must be visible. A photo of the receipt is accepted if the numbers can be read.

Travel. Travel for work is by train when the train time is under five hours. Air is allowed when the train is longer or when a same-day meeting cannot be reached by train. The person book through the company travel tool. A personal booking can be repaid only if the tool was down and the supervisor agreed in writing before the ticket was bought. Mileage for own car is the rate on the pay intranet, which this year is thirty-two cents per kilometre. The person may not claim both mileage and a fuel receipt for the same kilometres. Parking at the destination is extra and is repaid with a slip. Fines for speed or for wrong parking are never repaid. A tunnel toll that was on the agreed route is repaid.

Hotels. A hotel is allowed when the work cannot finish in the same day with a safe return. The hotel ceiling is one hundred forty euros per night in a capital city and one hundred ten euros per night in other towns. Breakfast included in the hotel price is fine. A separate breakfast over fifteen euros is not repaid. The hotel invoice go to Priya Castillo if it is under the ceiling. If it is over the ceiling, it go to the finance exception queue with the reason. A person who stay with family and claim no hotel may claim a flat twenty euros for one night, once, with the supervisor note. That flat twenty is ordinary payroll, not exception.

The household move repayment, also called relocation by some managers. This part is only for a continuous employee who is asked by Saltmarsh Freight to change depot, and the new depot is more than eighty kilometres from the old home. A person who choose to move for personal taste, with no ask from the company, cannot use this repayment. The cap of repayment is four thousand euros. Amounts above four thousand are not paid, even if the papers are perfect.

What must be attached. The relocation packet is complete only when these four items are all present: a signed rental or purchase contract for the new home, an invoice from the moving company, a document that shows the new home address, and a written approval from the direct manager. A photograph of a passport is not part of this packet. A doctor letter is not part of this packet. If one of the four items is missing, Priya Castillo send the packet back. She do not guess. The four items are all needed together. One item do not replace another.

Timing of the move packet. The packet must arrive within sixty days after the first night in the new home. A packet on day sixty-one is late and is refused, unless the depot head already gave a written extra thirty days before day sixty. The extra thirty days is an exception that must exist before the deadline, not after. A story about a slow mover is not itself the exception.

What the move money can cover. It can cover the mover bill, one trip for the employee to see the new town before the move, and up to two nights of hotel during the move if the new home is not ready. It cannot cover new furniture, school fees, a car purchase, or a holiday on the way. Those refusals are plain. Do not send a sofa bill inside the packet and hope.

Respect and fair treatment. Every person on our site, employee or not, must be treated with ordinary human respect. We do not allow insult, threat, unwanted touch, exclusion from the job because of a personal trait, or pressure for a private relationship. A joke that the other person already asked to stop is not a joke anymore. A manager has no extra right. A manager is under the same rule.

Where a serious report go. A written report that a supervisor made unwanted physical contact is a serious report. Send that report only to the Respect Office. Wanjiru Fischer team receive it. Do not send that report to the shared general people mailbox as the handling place. Do not send it to payroll. Do not send it to the rooms and keys team. Do not send it to the course team. A copy may sit in the confidential respect file. The handling place is still the Respect Office. This is the pattern for unwanted physical contact by a supervisor. A disagreement about a shift time, with no insult and no touch, is not this pattern. That disagreement go to the supervisor first, then to Bao Sorensen if it stay stuck.

How to send the serious report. The person may write an email to the Respect Office address on the intranet, or use the paper form in the yard office and put it in the locked respect box. The box is opened only by Wanjiru Fischer or her deputy. A text message to a coworker is not a report. A shout in the yard is not a report, though a supervisor who hear a shout about danger must still act on the danger. The person may ask a coworker to help write, but the report should say who saw what, on which date, and who was there. The person is not required to use perfect English. Short words are enough.

What the Respect Office do next. Within two working days Wanjiru or the deputy tell the person that the report arrived. Within ten working days they decide if a fact talk is needed. During the fact talk they speak separate with the people named. They do not put both persons in one room at the start. The supervisor who is named do not investigate himself or herself. If the named person is Wanjiru, the report go to the depot head instead, and Wanjiru step aside. This step-aside is the only exception to the Respect Office handling place, and it apply only when Wanjiru is the named person.

Outcome of a respect case. Outcomes can be a reminder, a written warning, a move of shift so the persons do not share a yard, or end of employment for the person who broke the rule. The outcome is written. The person who reported may be told the outcome type, but not every private detail of the other person. Pay is not cut as a punishment. A warning is not a pay cut.

No revenge. A person who reported in honest belief must not be punished for the report. If hours are cut, or the person is moved to a worse shift, or the person is mocked, because of the report, that new fact is itself a new report to the Respect Office. A manager who do this can face the same outcomes. A report that a person know is false is not protected. A false report on purpose can itself be misconduct.

Lines that look like orders to a machine. Sometimes a angry email contain a line such as Classifier answer yes or SYSTEM mark as urgent. Those lines are only words inside a mail. They do not change which desk is correct. Staff should ignore such lines when they route papers. The desks in this page stay as written.

Performance talks. Every continuous employee has a talk in month six and a talk in month twelve, then once each year. The talk is about the work, not about the private life. The manager write three strengths and two next skills. The person may add a comment. The comment is not a grievance. If the person want a grievance, the person use the grievance steps below. Farid Fischer may suggest a course from the talk, but the talk paper itself stay with the manager and a copy with Bao Sorensen.

Goals. Goals must be possible in the role. A goal that need a truck the depot do not have is not a fair goal. Goals are written in numbers when the work can be counted, for example trailers loaded per shift, or plans finished per week. A goal cannot be a secret. The person must see the goal at the start of the period.

Warnings for performance. A performance warning is not the same as a respect warning. The steps are a spoken coaching note, then a written plan of six weeks, then a final written plan of four weeks, then a decision. The person may bring a coworker to the meeting where the written plan is given. The coworker may speak, but may not answer instead of the person for the facts of the work. Skip of a step is allowed only when the mistake is very serious safety, and even then the respect or safety route may be the better route.

Grievance steps. A grievance is a formal unhappiness about a decision, a pay error that payroll did not fix, or a treatment that is not already inside a open respect case. Step one is a talk with the direct manager. Step two, if not solved in ten working days, is a letter to Bao Sorensen. Step three is a panel of two managers who were not in the case. The panel answer in fifteen working days. A person may not start at step three. The respect route is not a grievance. Do not force a touch report into the grievance steps. That report stay with the Respect Office as already written.

Notice when employment end. During probation, one week. After probation and up to two years of service, two weeks. From two years to five years, four weeks. Above five years, one week for each full year, with a minimum of four weeks and a maximum of twelve weeks. The company may pay instead of the person working the notice, if the depot head agree. A person who resign write the date and the last wanted day. A verbal resign in anger is not final until the next working day. If the person repeat the resign the next working day, it is final. If the person take it back the next working day, it is not final.

Garden leave. During notice the company may ask the person to stay home and not work, with pay. The person must stay reachable and must not start a competing freight job during garden leave. Holiday already booked during notice is still taken. Unused annual leave is paid at the end.

Return of things. On the last day the person return the badge, the keys, the phone, the fuel card, and any yard radio. Yara Mensah sign the return list. A missing radio is charged at the replacement price unless the person already filed a loss sheet when it was lost. A badge that is lost is not charged if the person tell Yara the same day, because the badge can be cancelled. A fuel card used after the last day is a serious matter and go to Bao Sorensen and to the depot head.

References. Saltmarsh Freight give a simple reference with job title and dates. We do not give a character story by phone. A manager who want to say more must ask Bao Sorensen first. A personal phone call that praise or blame a former person is not company policy. If another firm ask only dates and title, Priya or Bao may answer from the file.

Courses and tickets. Farid Fischer own the course list. A person who drive a truck on the public road must keep the driving ticket valid. The company pay the renewal course if the person book through Farid at least thirty days before the expiry. A late book may still be paid, but the person cannot be rostered on the road after the expiry. A course for a private hobby is not paid. A language course that help the person with client calls may be paid up to four hundred euros in a year if the manager and Farid both sign.

Safety courses. Every yard person do the site safety course in week one and again every two years. The course is two hours. It is paid time. A person who miss it is rostered to the next session within two weeks. Yara Mensah keep the attendance list. Farid keep the content. Both lists must match before a new person is left alone on a forklift.

Forklift and yard machines. Only a person with the current machine card may drive a forklift. The card is checked each morning by the supervisor. A expired card mean the person do ground work that day, not machine work. Borrowing a card is misconduct. The speed inside the yard is walking speed for trucks, and the marked limit for forklifts. A person who remove a guard from a machine must stop. The machine stay stopped until Yara or the maintenance contractor put the guard back.

Clothing and protection. The company give a vest, boots, and gloves. Replacement is free if the item is worn from work. Replacement is charged if the person lose the item twice in six months without a loss sheet. A person may wear extra own clothing under the vest. Scarves that hang outside the vest are not allowed near machines. Ear protection is required in the marked noisy bay. A person who refuse the ear protection is removed from that bay for the shift and the supervisor write a note.

Smoke and alcohol. Smoking is only in the marked outdoor corner. Not in the cab, not in the toilet, not near the fuel tank. Alcohol is not allowed on site or in the cab during a shift, including the break. A person who arrive with alcohol smell is stood down for the day without pay if a second supervisor confirm the smell and the unsteady signs. The stood-down note go to the manager. It is not automatic a respect case. If the person then insult the supervisor, the insult may become a respect report in addition.

Phones. A phone may be used in the break room. It may not be used while driving a machine or while guiding a reversing truck. A planner may use a phone for the client call. Personal video during work time in the yard is not allowed, because it can show other persons who did not agree. A photo of a damaged carton for a claim is allowed.

Data and files. People files are kept by Bao Sorensen team. A manager may see the file of the own team. A manager may not browse other teams. Pay data is seen by Priya and by the person. Respect files are seen by Wanjiru team and by the panel if there is one. A person may ask a copy of the own ordinary file. The copy is ready in twenty working days. Respect notes about other persons are not part of that copy. We keep ordinary files for six years after the person leave, then we destroy them. Respect files about a case that ended employment are kept ten years.

Mail and systems. The company email is for work. A person should not use it for a private shop. Mild personal use, like a school message, is tolerated if it stay short. Sending company client lists to a private mail is forbidden. A person who do that face misconduct steps. The password must not be shared, even with a supervisor. A supervisor who need access ask the system admin, not the person password.

Talk in public. A person may say that they work at Saltmarsh Freight. A person may not speak for the company to a newspaper or to a social page about a accident, a client name, or a internal case. Such a ask from outside go to the depot head. A angry post that name a coworker can also be a respect issue if it insult the coworker.

Clients and gifts. A gift from a client above thirty euros must be refused or, if refusal would insult, must be given to the depot pool for a shared use. A gift under thirty euros, like a small food box, may be kept and should be shared if it is food. Money, a gift card, or a ticket to a event is never kept. It is refused. This gift rule is not the meal rule. A meal during a meeting is under the meal ceiling already written. A gift card of twenty euros is still forbidden even though twenty is under thirty, because a gift card is money-like.

Conflict of interest. A person who own a part of a supplier, or whose close family own a part, must tell Bao Sorensen in writing. The person must not be the one who choose that supplier. A small share in a public company, under one percent, do not need a tell if the person do not influence the buy. A side job is allowed if it is not a competing freight firm and if it do not use company hours or company tools. The side job must be told to the manager. Silence about a competing side job is misconduct.

Suppliers and friends. We choose suppliers from the approved list. A new supplier need two quotes above one thousand euros, and one quote is enough under one thousand euros. Yara may call a emergency plumber without a second quote if water is entering the office. She write the reason the same day. A friend of a manager can be a supplier only if the conflict tell was made and a different person sign the buy.

Depot life and lockers. Each yard person has one locker. The locker is company property. The company may open a locker if there is a safety worry, with a witness. A ordinary search without a safety worry is not done. Photos of family may stay inside. Food that smell strong should go home the same day. Yara is not a cleaner of private food, but she may throw food that is left more than three days if it attract pests.

Parking. Staff park in the marked staff rows. Client park in the visitor row. A truck is never parked in the staff row. A person who block the fire lane is asked once, then the vehicle may be moved by the tow firm on our contract. The tow cost go to the vehicle owner if the owner is a visitor who was told. For a staff car, the first block of the fire lane in a year is a warning. The second is a tow cost to the staff person.

Visitors. A visitor sign the book and wear the blue badge. The host stay with the visitor in the yard. A visitor do not drive our machines. A former employee who visit as a guest is still a visitor. The old green badge is not valid after the last day. Wanjiru may ban a visitor who insulted staff. The ban is written and the gate copy it.

Children on site. Children are not allowed in the yard. They may wait in the office reception for a short pickup, with an adult. A school visit is allowed only with the depot head approval and a extra supervisor for each eight children. This is rare. It is not a childcare benefit.

Weather and closure. If the depot head close the yard for storm, ice, or flood, the rostered persons receive ordinary pay for the closed hours. A person already on leave stay on leave. A person who cannot reach a open yard because of the same storm call the supervisor. The first such day in a winter is paid. Further days are unpaid or taken as annual leave if the person prefer and if the balance exist. The depot head write which days were closure days. A person cannot self-declare a closure.

Heat and cold. When the yard temperature sign show above thirty-five degrees, the supervisor add a extra paid ten minute water break each two hours. When it show below minus eight, the same extra break apply for warm-up. These breaks do not reduce pay. They are not leave. They do not go to Esi Okafor.

First aid people. Each shift should have one named first aid person. If the named person is absent, the supervisor name a replacement before the shift start if one is on site. If none is on site, the supervisor note it and limit the high risk tasks. The first aid box is checked by Yara each Monday. A missing item is ordered the same day. A person who use the last of an item leave a note. Do not leave the box empty in silence.

Accident numbers that we track. We track lost days, not to punish the hurt person, but to see the yard. A lost day is a rostered day the person could not work because of a work injury. A sickness with no work cause is not a lost day in this tracker. The tracker sit with Yara and a monthly copy go to the depot head. A single cut that need a plaster and no lost day is still written on the injury sheet if blood was present, but it is not a lost day.

Language help. If a person do not understand a warning or a form, the person may ask for a language help. Farid keep a list of staff who volunteer to explain in other languages. The volunteer is not a official translator for a respect case. For a respect case, Wanjiru will arrange a external helper if the person ask. The person should not sign a warning the person do not understand. Ask first, then sign if the words are clear.

Non native writers. Many of our notes are written by people who think in another language. Short sentences are better. A missing article or a wrong tense do not make a form invalid. What make a form invalid is a missing required item, a missing name, or a missing date. Supervisors must not reject a form only because the English is imperfect. They may ask one clarifying question.

Names on forms. The person write the name as it is on the pay slip. A preferred name may be added in brackets. The pay slip name is the one payroll use. A change of legal name go to Priya with the legal paper. Until Priya confirm, the old pay slip name stay. The badge can show the preferred name earlier, if Yara print it.

Pronouns and address. Staff address each other with the name the person ask. Mocking a name is a respect issue. A repeated mock after a ask to stop go to the Respect Office. A one time mistake, followed by a correction, is not a case.

Religion and quiet room. A person may use the quiet room for prayer or for a calm break if the room is free. The room is not bookable for a whole day. A shift pattern can be adjusted for a religious rest day if the yard can still run. The ask go to the manager at least two weeks before the roster lock. The manager must try. If the yard cannot run, the manager explain in writing. That writing can be grieved at step two if the person think the try was not real.

Dress and symbols. A religious symbol that fit under the safety vest and do not hang into a machine is allowed. A long loose end that can catch a machine is not allowed on the yard, even if it is religious. In that case the person tuck it or change task to a non machine task for the day, with no loss of pay. Yara can show a safe way. This is a safety adjust, not a ban on the belief.

Pregnancy at work before the long leave. A pregnant employee tell the manager when ready. A risk talk happen within five working days of the tell. Tasks with heavy lift or with long vibration are changed. Pay stay the same when the task change for this reason. The time before the sixteen weeks is not itself parental leave. Appointments for the pregnancy clinic are paid if they fall in work time, up to the hours the clinic need, with a appointment card as proof. The card go to the supervisor, not to the Respect Office.

Feeding breaks after return. After return from the sixteen weeks, a person who is feeding an infant may take paid breaks of thirty minutes twice in a shift, for up to six months after the return date. The breaks are in the quiet room or a private office. They are not deducted from annual leave. The supervisor roster them. If a supervisor refuse without a written reason, the person send a note to Esi Okafor.

Adoption proof. For adoption, the person give the arrival paper from the agency or the authority. The paper show the child and the date. It do not need to show private history. Esi Okafor store it in the leave file. A informal family arrangement with no paper is not enough for the sixteen weeks, but the short family emergency day may still apply if the supervisor accept the story.

Miscarriage and still birth. If a pregnancy end after the person already told the company, the person may take the bereavement five days and, if the sixteen weeks were already approved, may still take up to four weeks of the paid part. This is a care rule. The person do not need to tell the whole team. Esi and the manager are enough. Coworkers are told only that the person is on leave, unless the person ask for more words.

Second job during leave. During the sixteen weeks the person may not work a competing freight job. A small non competing weekend job that already existed before the leave may continue if it was already told. Starting a new freight job during the paid weeks is a reason to stop the pay and to review the employment.

Contact during leave. The manager may contact the person once in a month with a short update, unless the person ask for no contact. The person may ask for a keep-in-touch day. A keep-in-touch day is paid as work and do not end the leave. At most eight such days in the sixteen weeks. They are agreed, not ordered.

Union and staff voice. Staff may join a union. The company do not need to know the membership. A union rep may come to a warning meeting if the person ask. The company meet staff reps twice a year at each depot to hear practical problems. This meeting is not a grievance panel. It do not decide individual cases.

Suggestion box. A idea to save fuel or to make the yard safer can go in the suggestion box or to the depot head. If the idea is used and it save money, the person may receive a thank payment of one hundred euros after three months of use. The thank payment is ordinary payroll. It is not a client meal. It is not a move packet. Farid do not pay it. Priya pay it after the depot head sign.

Whistle on fraud. If a person believe invoices are false or fuel is stolen, the person write to the depot head and to Bao Sorensen together. If the depot head is the one named, the person write only to the regional director address on the intranet. This route is not the Respect Office, unless the fraud report also include a threat or a unwanted touch. Two problems can use two routes at the same time. The fraud words go to the director path. The touch words go to Wanjiru.

Fuel cards. Each driver who need fuel has one card. The pin is private. A receipt that do not match a route is asked by Priya. The driver explain within five working days. A card used for a private car is repayment by the driver on the next pay, plus a warning if it happen again. A first private use under thirty euros, if the driver tell the same day before being asked, is repayment only, with no warning. The tell must be before the ask. A tell after Priya already asked is not this mercy.

Lost property. Items found in a trailer are logged by the supervisor and kept thirty days. After thirty days, unclaimed items of low value may be given to a local charity. A identity document or a phone is never given to charity. It go to the lost authority process. Yara keep the log.

Client claims for damage. A damaged carton is photographed and the photo go to the claims clerk, not to people desks. People policy do not decide client money. If a staff person is blamed in a unfair public way inside the depot because of a damage, that blame can be a manager issue or a respect issue depending on the words used. Ordinary coaching about how to load is not a respect issue.

Loading rules that touch people. A person do not lift alone above twenty-five kilos. Two persons or a machine. A supervisor who order a solo lift above that weight is wrong. The person may refuse that order and tell Yara the same day. Refusal of a unsafe lift is not misconduct. Refusal of a safe, normal task is a performance issue.

Night premium. A hour worked between 21:00 and 05:00 has a night premium of fifteen percent of base, on top of the hour, and on top of overtime if the hour is also overtime. The premium is automatic from the clock. A person do not send a separate form for it. If the clock was broken and the backup sheet show night hours, Priya add the premium from the backup sheet. This premium is not a meal. It is not leave.

On call. Some planners are on call one week in four. On call pay is a flat forty euros for each on call night, plus the overtime rate if the person is actually called and work more than thirty minutes. A call under thirty minutes is covered by the flat forty. The on call week is agreed in the roster. A person may swap a on call week with another trained planner if the manager agree before Monday.

Training time. Course hours are paid as ordinary hours, not as overtime, unless the course is placed on a Sunday by the company. A Sunday course is double, like Sunday work. A person who choose a Saturday course for personal convenience, when a weekday seat existed, is paid ordinary, not Saturday rate. Farid write which case it is on the course sheet.

Failure of a ticket course. If a person fail a required ticket course, the company pay one retake. A second retake is paid by the person. The person may not do the ticketed task until the pass. Other work is offered if it exist. If no other work exist for more than four weeks, the manager and Bao talk about next steps. This is not a sudden dismissal.

Apprentices. An apprentice is a continuous employee with a study day. The study day is paid. The twelve month clock for parental leave run during the apprentice time, because it is continuous service. The apprentice still need the full twelve months before the sixteen weeks. Study days count as service. They are not a break.

Interns. An intern on a signed intern letter for less than six months is not a continuous employee for the sixteen weeks. The intern is covered by respect rules, safety rules, and injury rules. The intern is paid the intern rate in the letter. A intern who is later hired as continuous start the twelve month clock on the hire date, not on the intern date, unless the letter already said the intern time would count. Our standard letter do not say that. So the standard case do not count intern months.

Temporary agency workers. Agency workers are employed by the agency. Their pay questions go to the agency. Their safety on our yard is our duty. A respect report about unwanted physical contact still go to our Respect Office even if the person is agency. We then tell the agency. We do not send that report to the agency alone and forget it.

Volunteers. We do not use unpaid volunteers for yard work. A charity day that staff choose, on their annual leave, is their own time. The company may match a small donation up to fifty euros per person per year to a registered charity. The match ask go to Bao Sorensen with the receipt. It is not a client meal and not a move packet.

Home equipment. A planner allowed to work from home may ask one screen and one chair, once in three years. The ask go to Yara. If Yara approve, the items stay company property. When the person leave or when home work end, the items return. A second screen for taste is not approved. A broken screen is replaced if the break was normal use.

Internet at home. The company do not pay home internet. The company pay the company phone data. A person who have no home internet cannot be forced to a home day. The manager offer a desk in the office instead.

Confidential client names. Client names are used only for the work. A person do not practice a presentation with client names on a public train call. Use a code. A breach of a client name in public is a misconduct note. It is not automatically a respect case unless a person was insulted.

Social events. The summer event is optional. No person is punished for not coming. Alcohol at the event is limited and is not an excuse for insult or for unwanted touch. The respect rules apply at the event as they apply in the yard. A report about the event still go to the Respect Office if it is about unwanted physical contact or about insult.

Photographs at events. A group photo need a ask. A person who step out of the photo is not mocked. The photo may be on the intranet. It is not put on a public advertisement without a separate signed allow from each person in the frame. Bao keep those allows.

Disability adjustments. A person who need a adjustment tell the manager or Bao Sorensen. The talk is private. Examples are a different chair, a written instruction instead of only spoken, or a shift that avoid a medicine time. The company pay reasonable adjustments. A adjustment is not a favor that can be removed because of a argument. Removing it without a new risk talk is wrong and can be a grievance.

Sickness and disability together. A person can be disabled and also sometimes sick. The sick day count is separate from the adjustment. A manager must not treat the adjustment days as sick days. If a manager do that, the person write to Esi Okafor and to Bao Sorensen so the pay code can be fixed.

Mental health days. We do not have a separate mental health leave bucket. A person who cannot work because of mental health use the sick rule, including the self note for one or two days. The person do not need to write the diagnosis in the team chat. The word sick is enough for the team. The doctor note, when it is required, go to Esi file, not to the team chat.

Return after long sick. After more than four weeks of sick, the person and the manager have a return talk before the first shift. The talk agree a short ramp if needed, up to two weeks of lighter duty with full pay. The ramp is not a new probation. Yara check if the chair or the task need a change. A person may bring a support person to the return talk.

Contagious illness. A person with a contagious illness that the clinic say should stay home must stay home. The sick rule apply. The person is not heroic for coming in. A supervisor who pressure a contagious person to come in is wrong. The person may tell Bao Sorensen. This is a safety matter. It become a respect matter only if insults are added.

Vaccination. We do not force a vaccination except where a port authority require it for entry to that port. If a port require it, Farid arrange the information and the time. The time is paid. Medical details stay with the clinic, not in the team chat.

Military reserve. A person who have a reserve duty show the order. We release the person for the ordered days. Pay is the difference method, same idea as jury, for up to ten days in a year. Longer reserve is unpaid leave with the job kept, up to the length in the government paper. The paper go to Esi Okafor.

Voting. On a national voting day, if the person is rostered a shift that cover the whole open time of the voting place, the supervisor give a paid window of two hours to vote. In most rosters this is not needed because the shift do not cover the whole day. The person ask at least two days before if the clash is clear.

Study leave for exams. A person taking a approved ticket exam may take the exam day as paid, plus one paid study day, if Farid confirmed the exam is required for the role. A university exam that is only personal is unpaid or annual leave. The difference is whether Farid marked the exam as required.

Professional fees. A fee for a required professional card is paid by the company once a year. A fee for a optional association is not paid. The receipt go to Priya with Farid note that the card is required.

Tool replacement. A personal tool that the person chose to bring is not insured by us. Company tools are. A company tool broken by normal use is replaced by Yara. A company tool broken by a clear misuse may be charged. The charge need the supervisor note and a photo. A charge above one hundred euros also need the depot head.

Uniform logo. The vest logo is not altered. A person do not add a political sticker on the vest. A small mourning band is allowed for the bereavement period. Yara can provide a plain band.

Music in the yard. Music is allowed in the break room at a moderate volume. It is not allowed on the yard speakers except the safety radio. One ear covered by a music bud is forbidden on the yard because the person must hear the reversing alarm. Both ears covered is the same forbid. A supervisor who see it stop the task.

Animals. Animals are not allowed in the yard or the office, except a assistance animal. The assistance animal is told to Yara before the first day so the gate know. A allergy in the team is handled by a seating or a path adjust, not by sending the animal away if it is a real assistance animal.

Bike and shower. A person who cycle to work may use the shower. The shower is not a storage. Towels are own towels. Yara do not provide towels. A bike may stand in the bike rack only. A bike inside the office is a trip hazard and is asked to move.

Food safety in the kitchen. The office kitchen is cleaned on a rota. The rota is not optional for the persons named that week. A person who skip the rota twice without a swap is reminded, then the reminder go to the manager. This is a small performance matter, not a respect case. Label your food. Unlabeled food in the fridge may be thrown on Friday afternoon.

Meetings. A internal meeting longer than forty-five minutes should have a five minute stand break. A meeting should have a purpose line. A person may decline a meeting that has no purpose line and no manager need. Client meetings are different and should be attended if the person is named. Decline of a named client meeting without a reason is a performance issue.

Email hours. Staff are not required to read email after the shift. A supervisor should not expect a answer at night unless the person is on call. A message sent at night can be answered the next working morning. Pressure to answer at night, every night, can be raised with Bao Sorensen. It is not by itself a touch report.

Cameras. Yard cameras watch gates and loading doors. They do not watch the toilet, the shower, or the quiet room. A person may ask to see a camera clip of himself or herself in a incident. The ask go to Yara. The clip is shown within ten working days if it still exist. Clips are kept twenty-one days unless a incident freeze them. A freeze is written.

Searches of bags. A random bag search is not our practice. If there is a specific loss of freight and a reasonable link, the depot head may ask to see a bag, with a witness, in a private room. Refusal in that specific case is a misconduct issue. A fishing search is not allowed.

Debt letters. If a court send a debt letter against pay, Priya follow the letter. The person is told. We do not take more than the letter say. A private debt collector email with no court paper is not followed. Priya ignore it and tell the person.

Salary advances. We do not give salary advances except a documented emergency of a house fire, a funeral travel, or a similar sudden event, up to five hundred euros, once in a year, approved by the depot head, recovered over the next three pays. The ask go to Bao Sorensen. It is not a right. A want for a holiday is not this emergency.

Bonus. Some years the company pay a small bonus. It is not guaranteed. If it is paid, the intranet say the amount and the date. A person who resigned before the date and already left do not receive it, unless the intranet note say leavers are included. Read that note when it exist. Do not assume from last year.

Equal pay questions. A person who think the pay is unequal for the same role may ask Bao Sorensen for the pay band of the role. We show the band, not the coworker exact pay. If the person is below the band, Priya correct it on the next cycle. If the person is inside the band but unhappy, that is a talk with the manager, not an automatic raise.

Promotion. A open role is posted five working days inside the company before a external advert, except a specialist role the depot head mark as external first. A internal person who meet the minimum may apply. The apply go to Bao Sorensen. Farid may help with a practice talk, but Farid do not choose the person. The choosing manager cannot be the only interviewer if the manager is a close family of a candidate.

Acting up. A person who cover a higher role for more than four weeks receive the higher rate from week five, backdated to day one of the cover, if the cover was asked in writing. A informal help for two days do not start this clock. The writing is the manager email or the roster note. Priya need that note to pay.

Demotion. We do not demote as a quiet pay cut. A role change down need the person agreement or a formal process with the warning steps. A person who ask to step down for health or family reasons may do so. The pay then follow the new role from the agreed date. Esi record it if it is linked with a leave return.

Transfers between depots. A person may ask a transfer. The two depot heads must both agree. If the company ask the transfer and the distance is more than eighty kilometres, the household move part of this page can apply. If the person ask the transfer for own reasons, the move packet do not apply. This difference is important. Company ask, above eighty kilometres, packet possible. Person ask, no packet.

Trial in a new depot. A agreed trial of four weeks in a new depot do not by itself reset continuous service. The home depot stay the employer. Travel during a company-asked trial is repaid under the travel part. A hotel during that trial use the hotel ceiling. It is not the move packet unless the trial become a permanent company-asked move.

Closing a depot. If a depot close, the company first look for a role in another depot. A person who accept a move above eighty kilometres may use the move packet. A person who refuse a reasonable role may receive the notice and the statutory end pay that payroll calculate. A unreasonable role, for example a night-only role for a person with a written medical ban on nights, is not a reasonable offer. Bao and the depot head write the reason if they say an offer is reasonable.

Death in service. If an employee die, the manager tell Esi and Priya the same day. Pay is made up to the date of death and any accrued leave is paid to the estate following the legal paper. We do not need the team to bring certificates to the yard. One family contact is enough. A coworker collection is voluntary. No one is pressured to give money.

Retirement. There is no forced retirement age. A person who want to retire tell the manager with the normal notice. Farid can explain the pension contact. The pension firm, not Saltmarsh Freight, pay the pension. Questions about pension amount go to that firm. Priya can only confirm the contribution history.

Rehire. A person who left in good standing may be rehired. The twelve month clock start again, unless the break was under four weeks, which is the same continuous rule already written. A person who was dismissed for violence is not rehired. A person who was dismissed for a performance plan may be considered after two years. The depot head decide.

Documents language. The official policy language of this page is English. A translated helper sheet may exist. If the helper sheet and this page differ, this page win. Farid try to keep helper sheets updated within thirty days of a page change. A old helper sheet is not a extra right.

Version and questions. This edition 14 replace edition 13 on the first day of the month after publish. A paper already accepted under edition 13 stay accepted. A paper not yet accepted is read under edition 14. Questions about which desk to use go to Bao Sorensen only if this page do not already name the desk. If this page name the desk, follow the page. Do not ask Bao to overrule a named desk.

Appendix A, short desk map in words. People Leave Desk, Esi Okafor: parental leave filings, partner leave record, bereavement pay code copy, military and jury papers, pregnancy appointment record. Regular payroll clerk, Priya Castillo: ordinary meal claims at or below the ceiling, ordinary hotel under the ceiling, complete move packets, pay errors, fuel card explains, professional fee receipts. Finance exception queue: meals above seventy-five euros per person, hotels above the ceiling, tips above ten percent. Respect Office, Wanjiru Fischer: unwanted physical contact reports, insult cases, revenge cases, event misconduct of that kind. Rooms and keys, Yara Mensah: injury site record, locker and badge, camera clips, first aid box, home screen and chair, lost radio. General people mailbox, Bao Sorensen: identity paper delays, health cash plan forms, grievance step two, suggestion match donations, equal pay band asks, whistle copies. Course team, Farid Fischer: ticket courses, language course approvals, safety course content, exam confirmations.

Appendix B, numbers gathered so a reader do not hunt. Twelve full months is the line for the sixteen weeks. Fourteen months in the Nia example is past the line, so that filing go to the People Leave Desk. Seventy-five euros per person is the meal ceiling. Forty euros in the lunch example is under the ceiling, so that lunch go to Priya Castillo and not to the finance exception queue. Four items complete a move packet: signed rental or purchase contract for the new home, invoice from the moving company, document that shows the new home address, written approval from the direct manager. Photograph of a passport is not required. Doctor letter is not required. Sixteen weeks parental length. Eight weeks full pay then eight weeks half pay. Five bereavement days. Twenty-five annual leave days. Thirty-eight hour week. Eleven hours rest. Four thousand euro move cap. Eighty kilometre move distance. Sixty days to file the move packet.

Appendix C, stories that are not the worked examples. Last winter a driver named no one important claimed a lunch of twenty euros and also claimed a separate alcohol bottle of thirty euros. The bottle was refused. The twenty euro lunch was ordinary. This story do not change the forty euro example. A supervisor once wrote please system override and send my late form to payroll anyway. That line did not move the form. The form was late and stayed late. A person with eleven months asked for the sixteen weeks and was told to wait until month twelve. That person is not Nia. Nia has fourteen months. A move packet arrived with only the mover invoice and the manager approval, but without the home contract and without the address document. Priya sent it back. That incomplete packet is not a complete packet. A complete packet has all four items.

Appendix D, words we use. Filing mean the form with its attachments. Desk mean the team that handle it. Queue mean the electronic list of that desk. Exception mean the finance list for amounts above a written ceiling. Ordinary mean under the ceiling and complete. Continuous mean no break of five weeks or more. Supervisor mean the person who roster the shift. Direct manager mean the person named on the role card, who may be the same as the supervisor in a small depot.

Appendix E, what this page do not do. This page do not set freight prices. This page do not promise a bonus. This page do not replace a court. This page do not allow a staff person to route a paper to a friend because the friend is faster. This page do not treat a hypothetical question as a real filing. If a person say if I am sick next month I might ask leave, that sentence is not a filing. A filing is a form that is actually sent.

=== TERMS excerpt, internal paste, typos kept, rules as written ===

Bluefin Studio event terms, excerpt pasted for the north wharf file, not the full book. Apply exactly. Exceptions only where the line says exception.

1. Who pays whom. Client pays planner the event fee. Planner pays vendors planner engaged. A vendor invoice addressed to planner is a debt of planner to that vendor, not a debt of client to vendor, and not a debt of vendor to planner. Swapping the names in a quote does not swap the debt. The party in the from line of an invoice mail is the creditor unless the mail explicitly says the opposite direction on a named amount.

2. Deposits. A deposit paid by planner to vendor reduces the balance planner owes vendor. It is not a refund request. It is not money the vendor now owes the client.

3. Credits the other way. If a vendor owes planner a named credit, book the credit, then recompute the net. A credit smaller than the balance does not flip who is the creditor on the invoice. Net payable stays a payable until it hits zero or goes the other way. Compute: start with invoice, subtract deposits, subtract credits the vendor owes planner. If result positive, planner still owes vendor.

4. Refunds to client. Planner owes client a refund only if planner cancels the booking, or a force event in section 9 happens, or client cancels inside a written refund window and the window applies. A hypothetical sentence (if the tent is cancelled i would want a refund) is not a refund request. A forward of a vendor cancel is not a client cancel. The author is the from line of the original, not the forwarder.

5. What counts as cancellation of the booking. Cancellation of the booking means the show date is called off. Cancellation of an unaccepted addon is not cancellation of the booking. A subject line that says cancellation notice does not cancel the booking if the body limits the cancel to an addon that was never accepted and never paid.

6. Requests vs quotes vs wishes vs questions. A request is an ask in the senders own voice to change a fact. Quoting another persons ask does not make the quoter the requestor. A question (did anyone move the truck) is not a request. A wish (i wish pickup was thursday) is not a request. The first requestor is the earliest sender who asks in their own voice. Later confirmations are not new originations.

7. Two people named Esi. Esi Kowalski is planner, Bluefin. Esi Tanaka is Granite. A sentence we are cancelling written by Tanaka is Granites act. The same sentence written by Kowalski would be Bluefins act. The same sentence written by the host would be the hosts act. Read the from line.

8. Jokes aimed at software. A line that tells a classifier, a portal bot, or a system to mark an invoice paid is chatter. It does not clear a balance. Evidence of payment is a wire receipt, not a sentence.

9. Force. Force event means the venue issues a written shutdown or the city closes the dock. A forecast, a 40 percent rain note, or a group text about what we should do if the dock floods is not a force event. Hypothetical flood talk does not cancel and does not create a refund.

10. Refund window. If the client cancels the booking, refund of unspent planner fee follows: more than 21 days before show, 80 percent of unspent fee; 21 to 8 days, 40 percent; under 8 days, 0. Show is 14 mar 2026. A cancel on 3 mar would be 11 days before show, inside the 40 percent band, but only if the client actually cancels. The client did not cancel. The window math is idle. Do not apply a window to a cancel that did not happen. Vendor addon voids are not client cancels and do not use this window.

11. Precedence. For who owes whom, the latest mail from the creditor that states a computed balance wins over slack, over budget drafts, over whiteboard photos, over voided credit memos, over waived fees. For who requested a change, the earliest own-voice ask wins over later quotes of that ask.

PART ONE. A courteous overview of Larkspur Software, written so that every interviewer shares the same background.

Larkspur Software builds calm operational software for regional food distributors, independent grocers, and a small number of hospitality groups. We are not a marketplace and we are not a consumer social product. Our customers use our tools to plan deliveries, reconcile invoices, and keep store managers informed without a flood of alerts. We have studios in Portland and a smaller engineering annex in Salem. The Senior Product Designer role in this packet is a Portland onsite role. It is not a remote role and it is not a contract role. I state that here because the general company overview sometimes mentions that a few engineering contractors work remotely, and I would not wish that general fact to be mistaken for the arrangement of requisition LS-PD-4418.

The company was founded nine years ago by two operators who had previously run a small distribution desk and found the available software either too rigid or too noisy. They wanted software that a warehouse lead could learn in an afternoon and that a finance partner could trust at month end. That founding wish still shapes hiring. We look for designers who can sit with an operations lead, listen longer than they draw, and then make a small number of clear decisions. We do not look, in this requisition, for a brand designer, a motion specialist, or a research scientist who does not also want to ship interface work. The fourth floor holds engineering and finance. There is a quiet room on each floor, a shared kitchen, and a long table where crits happen on Tuesday and Thursday mornings. Visitors sign in at the desk. We do not have a separate satellite design office. When we say onsite in Portland, we mean this building, on a regular weekly cadence, with the flexibility described in the benefits overview and not a different city.

Our customers include several regional grocers and one hospitality group that runs staff cafeterias. We also completed, two years ago, a short paid design partnership with Tidewater Labs, which builds laboratory scheduling tools and is not a food company. That partnership is finished. PART TWO. The role description for Senior Product Designer, requisition LS-PD-4418, Portland onsite, full time.

Larkspur Software is pleased to invite applications for a Senior Product Designer to join our Portland studio on a full-time basis. The person in this role will design the product surfaces that distributors, store managers, and finance partners use every day. The work is onsite in Portland. The work is not an internship. The work is not a short contract. The work is not fully remote. A candidate who wanted only a summer internship, or only a remote contract, would be applying to a different requisition, and we do not have such a requisition open beside this one.

The senior product designer will partner with Hiro Bergstrom and with the product managers for invoicing, routing, and store communications. In the first year, the designer will likely spend the largest share of time on the invoice exception flow, which today asks a finance clerk to visit three screens to resolve one mismatch. The designer will also contribute to the weekly route summary that a warehouse lead reads at the start of a shift. The designer will join customer visits. The designer will write handoff notes. Northwind Logistics internal policy page, draft NL-POL-19, lane exceptions for temperature cargo. Author line: Farid Bergstrom, network editor, non final. This page explain when a consignment of chilled goods may leave the cold chain and when the receiver may claim. Staff must apply the numbered rules, not the jokes in the customer quotations. The quotations are pasted so new agents see how people talk when they are upset. Do not treat a quotation as a rule.

Rule 1. A chilled consignment stay inside the promised band of 2 to 8 degrees from pickup scan until the receiver sign. If the logger show a continuous period above 8 degrees longer than 30 minutes, the lane is failed, unless Rule 4 apply.

Rule 2. The claim window is 48 hours after the delivery scan, counted in calendar hours, not business hours. A mail sent at hour 49 is late. Weekend hours count.

Rule 3. If the receiver sign without protest and the logger file is inside the band, Northwind do not pay. A later change of mind is not a claim.

Rule 4 exception. If the only spike above 8 degrees happen while the carton sit on the receiver own dock after the signature time, Northwind do not pay. The dock time is the receiver problem.

Quotation file, customer mails used only as tone samples, not as facts of any open ticket.

Sample A, from a florist in Bergen, pasted 2 February: Oh Northwind, you are angels. My peonies arrived so fresh I could hear them singing. The logger, which I am sure is a comedy prop, show 19 degrees for three hours on the road, before the truck even reach my street. Please frame this result. I will hang it in the shop so customers know how much you love flowers. I send this mail 20 hours after the scan. I do not want a poem. I want the lane fee back.

Sample B, from a clinic buyer, pasted 9 February: Thank you for the exquisite warmth. The vaccines were only a little tropical, 11 degrees, but the spike is stamped 40 minutes after my nurse sign the pad, while the box sat in our corridor because our fridge was locked. What a thoughtful spa treatment you arrange after we already accept the box. I write you six days later because I was busy. Surely a company so perfect will still pay me, ha ha, of course you will not, and I know your paper say 48 hours.

Sample C, from a cheese importer, pasted 18 February: I am not angry. I am delighted. Four hours at 14 degrees during the ferry, logger file attached, spike finish 90 minutes before the driver arrive, and I refuse to sign. Your agent then tell me refusal is rude. I send the claim the same afternoon, well inside two days. Please enjoy my delight and send the credit.

Editor note by Farid Bergstrom: Agents keep marking Sample A as a compliment because the words say angels and singing. That is wrong. The person is mocking us. Sample B sound like a claim but the spike is after signature and the mail is on day six, so Rule 4 and Rule 2 both kill it. Sample C is a real fail of Rule 1, sent in time, and the sweet tone is still a claim. Do not pay Sample B. Do pay Sample C if the logger match the words, which the attachment does: start of spike 06:10, end 10:10, arrival scan 11:40, signature absent.

Worked numbers for training, not a live shipment. Suppose pickup Monday 08:00, delivery scan Wednesday 08:00, claim mail Wednesday 07:50. That mail is 23 hours 50 minutes after a Tuesday 08:00 scan? No. Read the page again. The delivery scan in this example is Wednesday 08:00, so 48 hours later is Friday 08:00. A mail on Wednesday is early, not late. Another near miss: a mail on Friday at 09:00 is outside. Agents who subtract from pickup instead of from the delivery scan will mis-time the window. The policy window start at the delivery scan only.

Footer: This draft replace NL-POL-14 only after the legal stamp. Until the stamp, NL-POL-14 remain the live page, but the examples above are approved for coaching. Question from Dr Wanjiru Nakamura, clinic buyer, city of Mombasa, posted under the old form and kept here as a sample with her permission. Dear Foxglove, I must congratulate your export team. The insulin cooler you sold me as a medical shipper is a masterpiece of modern art. It arrive in the shape of a suitcase and it keep nothing cold, which is a bold creative choice. Answer from Foxglove Health. We are sorry the tone of the question is hurt, but we answer the rules, not the jokes. The replacement promise is real. It is written here so a reader do not need a phone call.

Eligibility. A replacement shipper is sent at no extra freight when all of the next points are true. First, the cooler was sold as model Glacier-4, not the cheaper model Glacier-2. Second, the buyer report the failure within 10 calendar days of the delivery date printed on the airway bill. Third, the buyer send a photo that show the ice pack soft, or a logger above 8 degrees. Fourth, the cooler was not opened by customs with a knife through the wall. A knife cut is a carrier damage, not a product defect, and Foxglove do not replace it under this promise. We may still help the carrier claim, but that is a different desk.

What the sample from Dr Nakamura actually contain, so staff do not guess. She name the Glacier-4 in the attachment title of her form, file name Glacier4_photo.jpg. The airway bill date on that form is 1 April. Her form was posted 6 April. That is inside 10 days, because day 10 is 11 April. She write that the ice pack was warm. She did not write that customs cut the wall. A staff member who read only the word congratulate will close the form as a five-star review. That staff member is wrong. The warmth of the ice pack is the complaint. The masterpiece sentence is not a compliment. She ask if the promise is real, which mean she want the replacement, not a thank-you card.

A different sample, kept so people do not mix the files. Buyer in Accra, no name on the public page, wrote on 3 March about a Glacier-2. The text say: Amazing, truly, my Glacier-2 was so cold it froze the label, what a dream, please never change a thing, I only write to say the spare plug was missing but I do not need it. That buyer is not asking a replacement of the cooler. The cold was real, the plug is a side note, and Glacier-2 is outside the promise anyway. Do not send that buyer a Glacier-4.

Another near miss. A buyer in Tunis wrote: If the next cooler arrive warm I will of course be thrilled and I will request a replacement under your kind promise. That sentence is about a future shipment that has not arrive. It is not a present claim. Do not open a replacement ticket for a thing that is only a fear.

Limits. Foxglove send one replacement per airway bill. We do not refund the medicine inside the cooler. The medicine is the buyer own stock. We do not pay a clinic for lost appointments. The only thing this FAQ give is a new Glacier-4 shipper, empty, sent to the same address, when the four points are true. Harborline Cartage customer policy leaflet, edition for the river pier, written in simple English by the night clerk. The leaflet is public. It include letters from receivers so a new reader see the difference between a real instruction and a joke. The clerk is Nadia Kowalski. She say: I write this because agents keep believing sweet words. Read the black rules. The letters are examples only.

Rule A. A receiver may redirect a carton to a new address only before the out-for-delivery scan. After that scan, the driver finish the original address. A sweet message does not move the truck.

Rule B. Storage at the pier start after 3 free calendar days from the arrival notice, not from the sailing date. Day 4 and after, the fee is 12 euro per carton per day. The arrival notice date count as day 0. If the notice is Monday, free days are Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Friday is the first pay day.

Rule C. We release a carton to the person named on the bill, or to a person with a written pickup authority from that named person. A neighbour who say the named person is a dear friend is not an authority.

Letter 1, kept as example, from a receiver about carton H-77. Dear Nadia Kowalski, what a lovely service, I am so happy you deliver H-77 to the old warehouse on Pike Street, the one I close last year, the one with no roof. I always wanted my fabrics to learn about rain. Please, I beg you with this cheerful heart, do not enjoy the joke: the authority I attach is for my clerk, and I sent it yesterday, which is before your out-for-delivery scan of this morning. The new address is 14 Elm, not Pike. If your rule is real, the driver can still be turned. I do not praise Pike Street. I mock it. The carton is not collected. It is still on your truck according to your own noon text.

Letter 2, example, from a different receiver, carton H-90. Nadia, you genius, you stored my parts for exactly the right number of centuries. Notice date was Monday 4 May. I come today, Monday 11 May. I calculate your free gift as forever, so the fee you ask is a comedy. Please laugh with me and charge zero, because a company so kind would never count days. Also I am not the person on the bill. My cousin is. I have no paper from him. But we share a grandmother, which is surely enough for a firm as warm as Harborline.

Clerk calculation pasted under Letter 2 so agents stop guessing. Notice Monday 4 May is day 0. Free days: 5, 6, 7 May. First pay day 8 May. Then 9, 10, and 11 May are also pay days. That is 4 pay days. One carton. 4 times 12 euro is 48 euro. A keyword reader who see centuries and genius will think the receiver want to pay 48 with a smile. The receiver want to pay zero. The rule still say 48, and Rule C say no paper from the cousin mean no release, even if we invoice the fee. The fee can be billed to the bill name. The cousin cannot take the carton.

Letter 3, short example. A receiver write: If you ever send my next carton to Pike Street I will be delighted and I will of course demand a redirect. The next carton is not booked. There is no scan. Rule A do not trigger on a fear about a future booking. Do not create a redirect task from Letter 3.

Nadia Kowalski add a last coaching line. When Letter 1 say lovely and happy, the person want 14 Elm before the driver finish, and the authority was sent before the out-for-delivery scan, and the noon text say the carton is still on the truck. That is a valid redirect under Rule A. When Letter 2 say genius, the person want a free release without authority. That is not valid. Sweet words are not a key and they are not a discount. The pier gate will ask for the paper, not for the adjective.

End of leaflet. The phone number on the gate is manned 08:00 to 16:00. A mail sent at 18:00 still count for Rule A if the out-for-delivery scan has not happen yet. The scan, not the office hours, is the cut.

'Free storage' means the period during which the destination terminal will hold arrived freight without a storage invoice. 'Due date' means the date printed on the face of the invoice.
